name: mdn-web
title: MDN Web Docs: JavaScript, HTML, CSS and Web APIs

text.attribution: Credit the individual page title and URL and Mozilla Contributors; retain licence link, share adaptations under CC BY-SA and note changes.
text.conditions: Page-specific alternative licences override the default; exclude those pages pending separate review.

code_samples.attribution: Post-2010 CC0 snippets need no credit; pre-2010 MIT snippets require original author, revision year, copyright and licence notice.
code_samples.conditions: Legacy snippets have uncertain dates in the current site; do not assume CC0 when origin is not documented. Preserve page provenance and conservatively credit.
code_samples.evidence_quote: Code examples and snippets added on or after August 20, 2010 are in the public domain

exclude: Images, interactive examples and third-party assets
Pages marked as under an alternative licence

expected_size.note: Planning estimate only; no corpus has been fetched or measured.

update_cadence.note: Review weekly upstream content changes; record a per-page licence and authorship on any future import.

citation.format: MDN Web Docs: {title} — {url} (Mozilla Contributors, CC BY-SA 2.5)
